description: This file defines the ServeCommand structure conforming to ParsableCommand, responsible for orchestrating the 'serve' command in a command-line application. It handles configuration loading, initializes and starts a speech pipeline, processes speech segments, and manages wake word detection, logging, and transcript storage.

classes.name: ServeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command structure for running the Swabble service, including configuration parsing, speech pipeline management, wake word detection, and logging.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronous method that initializes configuration, starts the speech pipeline, processes incoming speech segments, performs wake word detection, logs activity, and optionally stores transcripts.

methods.name: matchesWake
methods.description: Checks if the given text matches the configured wake words.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes wake words from the beginning of the given text.
